title: SAM-D2Q: Aligning Multimodal Doc2Query with Search Demand and Conversion for E-commerce
title_zh: SAM-D2Q：面向电商搜索需求与转化的多模态 Doc2Query 对齐方法
abstract_en: E-commerce search often suffers from vocabulary mismatch between user queries and merchant-authored product titles, since short titles cannot fully cover diverse user expressions or visual product attributes. Although Doc2Query alleviates this issue by generating pseudo-queries for document expansion, traditional methods are text-only and not optimized for e-commerce business objectives. As a result, they may produce semantically plausible but commercially ineffective expansions and miss key attributes present in product images. To this end, we propose E-commerce Search-Aligned Multimodal Doc2Query (SAM-D2Q), a business-aligned multimodal document expansion framework for e-commerce search under Boolean retrieval constraints. SAM-D2Q consists of three stages: (1) task-adapted multimodal supervised fine-tuning to enhance vision-language understanding of product titles, images, and user queries; (2) multimodal data augmentation to improve perception of key visual attributes and expansion coverage; and (3) reinforcement-learning-based preference alignment toward search business objectives, encouraging the model to generate pseudo-queries that better match user intent and commercial value. Offline experiments show that SAM-D2Q substantially improves retrieval performance over traditional Doc2Query methods. Deployed in the AliExpress production search system, SAM-D2Q improves online business metrics, increasing GMV by +3.38% and Pay Count by +2.27%.
abstract_zh: 电商搜索中，用户查询与商家商品标题常存在词汇不匹配，短标题难以覆盖多样化的用户表达及商品视觉属性。传统 Doc2Query 虽可通过生成伪查询扩展文档，但通常仅利用文本，且未针对电商业务目标优化，容易生成语义合理但商业效果有限的扩展，并遗漏商品图片中的关键信息。为此，论文提出 E-commerce Search-Aligned Multimodal Doc2Query（SAM-D2Q），一种适用于布尔检索约束、面向业务对齐的多模态文档扩展框架。SAM-D2Q 包含三个阶段：任务适配的多模态监督微调，以增强模型对商品标题、图片和用户查询的视觉语言理解；多模态数据增强，以提升关键视觉属性感知能力和扩展覆盖率；基于强化学习的偏好对齐，以搜索业务目标为导向，生成更符合用户意图和商业价值的伪查询。离线实验表明，SAM-D2Q 显著优于传统 Doc2Query 方法。在 AliExpress 生产搜索系统中的在线部署显示，GMV 提升 3.38%，Pay Count 提升 2.27%。
key_points_zh: 针对商品标题与用户查询的词汇鸿沟，利用图片中的视觉属性进行多模态文档扩展。
通过任务适配的多模态监督微调，增强商品标题、商品图片与用户查询之间的跨模态理解。
采用多模态数据增强，提高关键视觉属性感知能力与伪查询生成覆盖率。
引入基于强化学习的偏好对齐，使生成结果更符合用户搜索意图及电商商业目标。
在 AliExpress 线上系统中实现 GMV 提升 3.38%、Pay Count 提升 2.27%。

llm_assessment.comment: This directly advances e-commerce retrieval through multimodal, business-aligned query expansion and validates substantial production gains in GMV and purchases.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作通过多模态且面向业务目标的查询扩展直接提升电商检索，并以显著的GMV和支付量线上增益完成验证。
